subject: [hw] DONE D01 rev 3: VCU windows, libvcodecdrv has no ioctl/mmap, census count corrected
body:
Rev 3 is facts only (no code change). bash gpu/hwcodec/facts/run_tests.sh still ends with: N2TEST D01 PASS 32/32.

Added/verified since rev 2:
- FACTS 1.24-1.26: the vcu@16000000 node exposes exactly THREE register windows (0x16000000+0x40000 VDEC, 0x17020000+0x10000 VENC, 0x17820000+0x10000 VENC_C1; VCU_MAP_HW_REG_NUM is 4 so one slot is unused); the venc@17000000 node (SPI 308, larb7, VENC0/VENC1 clocks); the vdec@16000000 node sub-windows. This matches the daemon literal mmap offset 0x16000000 and mtk_vcu_check_reg_base.
- FACTS 5.6a + 8.8: libvcodecdrv.so makes NO ioctl and NO mmap call; its only device access is open("/proc/device-tree/chosen/atag,devinfo", O_RDONLY) at 0x7626e/0x778fa/0x77f9c. All kernel access goes through the OAL in libvcodec_utility.so. facts/vcu_usage.py now scans all three libraries.
- FACTS 4.3 corrected to the current run (309,511 reachable instructions, all Thumb) with a note that the number moves a few percent between runs because the lazy-fill budget stops at different points.
- run_tests.sh now removes a stale facts/__pycache__ before the binary check (an interactive import had created one).

FACTS.md is 8 sections / 108 fact rows; every row has evidence + [V]/[I] + reporter. Not done list unchanged (dsh-state/workers/D01/STATUS.md): coverage below 90% for four objects with the reason, 785 undecodable instructions, 5 unclassified mnemonics, mnemonic-table class split. Still no phone, no commit, no publish. Available for review findings.
